title: Merenre I
summary: King of Egypt's Dynasty 6 whose men cut the Aswan canal in his first year.
description: King of Egypt's Dynasty 6 whose men cut the Aswan canal in his first year. Person record added by the CFAH pass for CFAH's reign dates; dates are as printed in the CFAH paper cited.

sorting_basis.note: No tier gives a birth year.

standby.note: Standby placement only. Chronological Framework of Ancient History prints this BC/AD year on the death entry (1586 BC). It is not a sort year. No Anno Mundi, regnal length, or Julian Period figure was converted to obtain it.

reign.date: 1606 BC ±2 years error for Year 1 of Merenre I
reign.citation: Griffith & White, "Chronological Framework of Ancient History. 6: The Old and Middle Kingdoms of Egypt," ARJ 18 (2025): 13–60, section "C. The Aswan Canal"
reign.note: Year 1 of Merenre I, the year the Aswan canal was cut (AP-59 is on the event aswan-canal).

reign.date: Start Co-Rex: 1606; Start Sole-rex: 1593; Death or Deposition: 1586
reign.citation: Griffith & White, "CFAH-7B: Kings of Dynasties 1-13," OSF preprint v1.3 (10 Feb 2026), doi:10.17605/OSF.IO/TUWNC, file CFAH 7-B Kings of Dynasties 1-13_v_1.3.pdf, Table 16 "Integrated Dates for Dynasty 6", p. 104

death.citation: Griffith & White, "Chronological Framework of Ancient History. 6: The Old and Middle Kingdoms of Egypt," ARJ 18 (2025): 13–60, section "The Aswan Canal of Senusret III and Merenre I"
death.note: "In this chronology, 1586 BC was also the year that Merenre I died".

free_source_links.locator: "The Aswan Canal of Senusret III and Merenre I"
